name: agile
description: Agile project-management skills for Claude Code and Codex. video-to-spec turns a narrated presentation video into SPECIFICATION.md, the source for brainstorming a feature with a coding agent: checks ffmpeg and openai-whisper, transcribes the narration, extracts one frame per slide and writes only what the video says, with citations, acceptance criteria when the video gives them, and open questions.
